The terms available are bad. They are better than March 1918's, and they cost the alliance permanently. The territory conceded is territory. The alternative on the present trajectory is the same territory conceded later by people with nothing to offer.-10MANPOWER -9MUNITIONS -2HOME STABILITY Speculative counterfactualSpeculative. Separate-peace soundings existed and none came to anything. The obstacle was never arithmetic. It was that the dynasty could not sign such a thing and remain the dynasty. What actually happened: Russia did not leave the war on its own initiative in 1917. It was taken out of it by revolution, first in March, when the Provisional Government that replaced the monarchy pledged to continue the war with the Allies, and again in November, when the government that replaced that one did not. The Emperor, who in this ending makes a separate peace, did not do so, and the Allies' loans went on until the revolution. A separate peace was talked about in the Empire's last years, and the talk was one of the things that discredited the court.Your commandMajor44 out of 100Ground held: the homeland held, with some losses; 0 places held or taken beyond the record, 1 lost or not
